evidencedFlags.--approval-mode <mode>: common to both; exec accepts approval flags (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/configuration)
evidencedFlags.--session-id <uuid>: pins the new session id; re-passing it continues that session (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/extending; verified on Muse Code 1.4.0)
evidencedFlags.exec: muse exec [OPTIONS] [PROMPT] — headless, prompt positional last (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/extending)
evidencedFlags.exit codes 0/1/2/130/143: 0 turn completes; 1 fails/cancelled; 2 usage error; 130/143 signals (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/extending)
evidencedFlags.-- <prompt>: ends option parsing; without it a leading-dash prompt exits 2 (verified on Muse Code 1.4.0)
evidencedFlags.--json envelope: run.output.delta {text}; run.terminal.<state> {terminal, text, reason} (verified on Muse Code 1.4.0)
